### ImageViewFitter

```ts
type ImageViewFitter = (bytes, maxDimension) => Promise<FittedReferenceImage>;
```

Decode one image and re-encode it for a model to look at: scaled within
`maxDimension` on the long edge (bounded by
[viewDimensionSchema](#viewdimensionschema)) as a lossy JPEG, so a viewer can
step the dimension down to meet a byte budget.

#### Parameters

| Parameter      | Type         |
| -------------- | ------------ |
| `bytes`        | `Uint8Array` |
| `maxDimension` | `number`     |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<[`FittedReferenceImage`](#fittedreferenceimage)\>
